_comment: Local marker_mission drone+arena simulator. Each drone exposes the marker_mission FC API on its fc_port, so the C2 lists them like real flight controllers (see the C2 fcs block below). Red home is the -Y end of the arena, blue the +Y end; drones spawn facing the enemy side.
_c2_hint: In marker_mission_c2/config.dev.json set fcs to: [{"name":"red1","host":"127.0.0.1","port":9101},{"name":"red2","host":"127.0.0.1","port":9102},{"name":"blue1","host":"127.0.0.1","port":9103},{"name":"blue2","host":"127.0.0.1","port":9104}]  — then run the C2 server + strategy and add the drones.
